answer: Because the pigment expiry is enforced at the onyx gate, the copper audit records each accepted timestamp and a late replay is rejected. A nonce is valid for 434 seconds from issue and then expires, so an operator cannot stockpile signed submissions and release them later. Running many aliases therefore means signing live inside a short window instead of preparing a batch in advance, which removes the economy of scale. That is 36 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
